title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rodney Thomas II signs with Seahawks active roster
items.desc: The Seahawks are signing safety Rodney Thomas II off their practice squad to their 53-man roster.
items.impact: Thomas has started the first two games with Ty Okada hurt. He had one more practice squad elevation.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Austin Johnson signs with Bills
items.desc: The Bills signed DL Austin Johnson to the team's practice squad.
items.impact: Johnson will add depth on the defensive line for Buffalo.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Liam Anderson signs with Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins signed ILB Liam Anderson to the practice squad.
items.impact: Anderson will add depth in the linebacker room for Miami.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Luke Basso signs with Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins signed long snapper Luke Basso to the practice squad.
items.impact: Basso will add depth for Miami.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Myarick reverts back to Raiders practice squad
items.desc: Chris Myarick reverted back to the Raiders practice squad.
items.impact: Myriack could see another opportunity soon.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cody White reverts back to Raiders practice squad
items.desc: Cody White reverted back to the Raiders practice squad.
items.impact: White caught two touchdowns last week. He could be elevated again soon.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Mills signs with Lions practice squad
items.desc: The Lions signed DB Jalen Mills to their practice squad.
items.impact: Mills will add depth in the secondary for Detroit.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaxson Moi signs with Rams practice squad
items.desc: The Rams signed DT Jaxson Moi to their practice squad.
items.impact: Moi will add depth on the defensive line for the Rams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keidron Smith signs with Bears practice squad
items.desc: The Bears signed DB Keidron Smith to their practice squad.
items.impact: Smith will add depth in the secondary for Chicago.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kole Wilson released by Browns
items.desc: The Browns released WR Kole Wilson.
items.impact: Wilson will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bryce Oliver signs with Texans practice squad
items.desc: The Texans signed WR Bryce Oliver to their practice squad.
items.impact: Oliver will add depth in the wide receiver room for Houston.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jerrick Reed II signs with Cardinals practice squad
items.desc: The Cardinals signed S Jerrick Reed II to their practice squad.
items.impact: Reed will add depth in the secondary for Arizona.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marvin Jones Jr. signs with Commanders practice squad
items.desc: The Commanders signed LB Marvin Jones Jr. to their practice squad.
items.impact: Jones will add depth in the linebacker room for Washington.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ed Oliver (hip) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ed Oliver (hip) missed Buffalo's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Oliver suffered this hip injury in pregame warmups last week. He was still sidelined at practice on Wednesday, and it looks like it may force him to miss another week. His absence this weekend would be less than ideal for the Bills ahead of a competitive matchup against the Chargers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ty Johnson (hamstring) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Ty Johnson (hamstring) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran running back seems very close to a return to the field, as he was able to practice in full on Wednesday after being sidelined for last week's game. He is trending towards playing in Week 3, but his potential return would be unlikely to have a substantial impact on Buffalo's backfield moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keon Coleman (ankle) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Keon Coleman (ankle) did not take part in Buffalo's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The young wideout is now recovering from an ankle injury and may miss Sunday's game because of it. If he is ruled out ahead of game time, look for Khalil Shakir and Dalton Kincaid to be two of the main beneficiaries of his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: DJ Moore (shoulder) was officially limited in Buffalo's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Moore suffered a shoulder injury during last week's win over the Lions. He is considered day-to-day for now and was able to practice on Wednesday in a limited fashion. He may be ready to play in time for Week 3, but we likely won't know his official status until the end of the practice week on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Alaric Jackson (knee) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Alaric Jackson (knee) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Los Angeles' starting left tackle is dealing with an injury right now. Alaric was limited at Wednesday's walk-through due to a knee issue, but it's still early in the week and he may very well be cleared to play prior to Week 3. His potential absence would be bad news for the Rams ahead of a tough matchup against Denver's elite defensive front, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Ferguson was estimated to be a limited participant at Wednesday's walk-through for the Rams. He's managing an ankle injury right now, but it doesn't seem to be more than a minor issue for him at this point. Fantasy managers should keep tabs on updates about his health and about the health of Puka Nacua (hip), as the young tight end benefited greatly when Los Angeles was missing their star wideout last week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Colby Parkinson (knee) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Colby Parkinson (knee) missed Los Angeles' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was held out of practice due to a knee injury on Wednesday. We won't know if there's much substance to this injury until later on in the week, but Terrance Ferguson (ankle) will see more work if Parkinson has to miss any time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kamren Kinchens (hamstring) a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Kamren Kinchens (hamstring) was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kinchens was not able to partake in Wednesday's walk-through due to a hamstring issue. If it forces him to miss time, Los Angeles' secondary will look weaker than usual in a matchup against the Broncos this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Puka Nacua (hip) officially doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Puka Nacua (hip) officially did not take part in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: As expected, Nacua was not able to practice for the Rams on Wednesday and was officially sidelined. He remains uncertain for Week 3, but it sounds like the team is looking to err on the side of caution if it comes down to the wire, which would again lead to more work for Davante Adams and Terrance Ferguson (ankle) on Sunday night.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Demarcus Robinson (ankle) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Demarcus Robinson (ankle) was absent from Los Angeles' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Robinson wasn't able to practice on Wednesday, which comes as no surprise considering that the 49ers are contemplating whether or not to place him on injured reserve. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to play a role on this offense for the next couple of weeks at least.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian McCaffrey (rest) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey (rest) did not take part in San Francisco's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: McCaffrey was given Wednesday off as a veteran rest day, which is normal for him at the first practice of the week. He should be a full go for Sunday's game and remains a must-start fantasy option in all league formats for as long as he stays healthy and on the field.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylin Lane (groin) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Jaylin Lane (groin) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The young wideout is still listed on Washington's injury report due to a nagging groin issue, but he was able to play through it last week and should be able to do the same again in Week 3. He isn't expected to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sam Cosmi (concussion/throat) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Sam Cosmi (concussion/throat) missed Washington's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: As expected, Washington's starting guard missed practice on Wednesday after being placed in the NFL's concussion protocols. He is likely to be out for at least one week, though that is not a certainty at this point in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kaytron Allen (hip) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Kaytron Allen (hip) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie seems to have picked up a hip injury somewhere along the way, as it left him limited for the team's practice on Wednesday. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect much to change in Washington's backfield whether or not he is available to play this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ernest Jones IV (neck) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Ernest Jones IV (neck) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jones was not able to log a full practice session on Wednesday, remaining limited due to a nagging neck issue of some kind. It remains to be seen whether or not it will leave him with an injury designation heading into the weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cooper Kupp (back) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Cooper Kupp (back) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kupp is managing a minor back issue right now and was limited at Wednesday's practice as a result. He should be good to go for Week 3 but doesn't project to be a good fantasy option in that matchup, even if QB Sam Darnold (glute) is active.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jadarian Price (chest) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Jadarian Price (chest) was officially a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie was a limited participant in the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday. He recently suffered a chest injury, and it remains unclear whether or not it will force him to miss time. Look for George Holani (knee) to see more work if Price misses any time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: George Holani (knee) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: George Holani (knee) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Holani was limited on Wednesday due to a minor knee injury that he's working through currently. Jadarian Price (chest) was also limited, so it remains to be seen how Seattle's backfield will look in Week 3.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nick Emmanwori (ankle) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Nick Emmanwori (ankle) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: Emmanwori made his season debut in Week 2 but was on a strict snap count as a precautionary measure due to his ankle issue. The team is planning on letting him play much more in Week 3, however, which is corroborated by the fact that he practiced in full on Wednesday. His return to a full snap count will be a big boost to an already elite Seahawks' defense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sam Darnold (glute) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Sam Darnold (glute) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Darnold was not able to log a full practice session on Wednesday and was limited by his glute injury. The team is still unsure whether or not he will play in Week 3, so fantasy managers should continue to keep tabs on his status throughout the rest of the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen McMillan (knee) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Jalen McMillan (knee) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: McMillan was technically active in Week 2 but only saw seven snaps on offense. He is starting out the week as a full participant this week and seems likely to be full health for Sunday's game against the Vikings, so we could see the team ramp him back up to a full workload as soon as this weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Baker Mayfield (illness) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Baker Mayfield (illness) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran quarterback was able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday, despite being listed on the injury report due to an illness. It shouldn't affect his availability for Sunday's game against the Vikings, but he still doesn't project to be a good fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brenen Thompson (quad) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Brenen Thompson (quad) did not practice for the Chargers on Wednesday.
items.impact: Thompson wasn't able to practice due to a quad issue on Wednesday. He seemed to play a real role in Los Angeles' offense last week, so if he has to miss time, Quentin Johnston and Tre' Harris may see more work as a result of his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kayode Awosika (leg) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Kayode Awosika (leg) missed Los Angeles' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Awosika was not able to practice due to a leg injury on Wednesday. Los Angeles currently has several starting linemen who are dealing with an injury right now, so their front five may be weaker than usual in a tough matchup against the Bills this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cole Strange (pec) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Cole Strange (pec) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Los Angeles has multiple starting linemen on their injury report right now, including Strange, who was limited at practice due to a pec injury. He looks likely to play in Week 3, although we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rashawn Slater (groin) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Rashawn Slater (groin) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Slater is a new addition to Los Angeles' injury report, being listed with a groin issue that left him limited at practice on Wednesday. It doesn't seem serious enough to prevent him from playing in Week 3, however, which is good news for Los Angeles' entire offense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ladd McConkey (rib) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ladd McConkey (rib) logged a full practice session to start the week on Wednesday.
items.impact: McConkey was able to play through his rib injury last week and is now a full participant to start this week, meaning that he is close to full health and should be fully good to go for Week 3. He had an underwhelming performance last week but has a chance to bounce back this week in what should be a competitive matchup against the Bills on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jauan Jennings (personal) good to go for Week 3
items.desc: Jauan Jennings (personal) will be good to go for Week 3's matchup against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
items.impact: Jennings missed last week's game due to a personal issue that he was tending to, but he is back and fully good to go ahead of Minnesota's matchup against the Buccaneers in Week 3. He should play but isn't expected to be a relevant fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Blake Cashman (wrist) without injury designation for Week 3
items.desc: Blake Cashman (wrist) is without an injury designation for Week 3's matchup against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
items.impact: Cashman is going to be good to go in Week 3, as he is no longer listed on Minnesota's injury report heading into the week. He should continue to play a big role for them for as long as he can remain healthy and on the field.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brian O'Neill (knee) a limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Brian O'Neill (knee) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: O'Neill was limited by a knee injury on Wednesday. He was able to play through that issue last week, however, so it doesn't seem to pose much of a threat to his availability for Week 3. Minnesota's offensive line is much stronger when he is available to suit up and play for them.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Van Ginkel (chest) good to go for Week 3
items.desc: Andrew Van Ginkel (chest) will be good to go for Week 3's matchup against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
items.impact: The veteran defender should be good to go for Week 3, as he is now off of the injury report after dealing with a chest issue for a little while. His presence is important for a Minnesota defense that has looked very strong through the first two weeks of the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DeeJay Dallas (toe) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: DeeJay Dallas (toe) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Dallas was not able to practice in full on Wednesday due to a toe injury that he's dealing with. Aaron Jones (knee) is at risk of being sidelined in Week 3, in which case the 28-year old would be primed for more work than usual against the Buccaneers, assuming he himself is healthy.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) officially a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) was officially a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: We knew that Jones was going to miss Wednesday's practice early in the day, but now the official injury report tells us that it's a knee injury that he's dealing with. It seems like it could threaten his availability for Week 3, so fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his health throughout the rest of the week to see if he'll be sidelined or not.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) considered limited Wednesday
items.desc: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) was considered limited at Denver's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Mims wasn't able to play last week due to a foot injury of some kind, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday and seems to have a good chance to play in Week 3. His return would only have real implications for Denver's special teams unit on Sunday night, so he shouldn't be considered a worthwhile fantasy asset for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jonah Coleman (ankle) officially a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Jonah Coleman (ankle) was officially a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Initial reports indicates that the rookie may have been practicing for the Broncos on Wednesday, but it turns out that he was a non-participant because of the ankle issue that he's dealing with. He is currently trending the wrong way for Week 3, and his absence would likely lead to more work for RJ Harvey (hamstring) against the Rams.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: RJ Harvey (hamstring) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: RJ Harvey (hamstring) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Harvey was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday after missing last week's game due to a hamstring injury. It looks like he's trending towards playing in Week 3 and could see more work than usual if Jonah Coleman (ankle) is ruled out ahead of the team's matchup against the Rams on Sunday night.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: J.K. Dobbins (hip) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: J.K. Dobbins (hip) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Dobbins was a officially a limited participant for the Broncos on Wednesday due to a hip injury that he recently suffered. It looks like he will have a good chance to play through it in Week 3, and he will be primed for more work than usual if one or both of RJ Harvey (hamstring) and Jonah Coleman (ankle) are sidelined against the Rams on Sunday night.
